layer_model: Layer A (Mac) runs the COMPLETE repository suite from a git checkout at the exact SHA (host-coupled + git-provenance infra tests execute); Layer B (Docker) runs the PR-relevant PORTABLE subset from the SAME exact-SHA git archive. A test relevant to the PR that cannot run in Linux Docker is REQUIRED_MAC_ONLY with a mechanical host-dependency justification and a proven Mac result.

src/tools/fixture-write-safety.selftest..host_dependency: resolves repository AUTHORITY SHAs via the local git object database (needs a .git checkout, not a bare tar)

src/**/evidence-integrity.selftest.mjs.host_dependency: git history/provenance inspection (fails with 'not a git repository' in a mount-free archive extract)

src/activation-path/launcher-failclose.s.host_dependency: macOS sysctl hw.model (hardware identity) + host process (claude) inspection

src/supervisor/supervisor-deadline-integ.host_dependency: pgrep host-process inspection for residual-process verification

src/safety_check/canonical-identity.self.note: safety_check infra, not PR #182/#183 code; executes green on Mac

pr182.REQUIRED_MAC_ONLY: git-provenance infra tests in the full suite (fixture-write-safety, evidence-integrity) execute on the Mac git checkout
pr182.NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_THIS_PR: all non-v8b2 repository selftests (executed in Layer A on Mac; not PR #182 code)

pr183.REQUIRED_MAC_ONLY: src/supervisor/supervisor-deadline-integration.selftest.mjs (pgrep host-process inspection) - PR-relevant (supervisor-session changed), executed green on Mac
pr183.NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_THIS_PR: all other repository selftests (executed in Layer A on Mac)

digest_canonicalization: sha256(JSON.stringify(object minus its own digest field), UTF-8, keys in insertion order; content is ASCII-only so UTF-8 and ascii-escaped forms are byte-identical)
